mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_export_request WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE data_export_request SET business_status=#{to},generated_export_log_id=COALESCE(#{logId},generated_export_log_id),operator_id=COALESCE(#{operator},operator_id),executed_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='COMPLETED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE executed_at END,version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id=#{id} AND business_status=#{from}

UPDATE data_export_log SET row_count=#{rowCount},file_sha256=#{fileSha256},file_size=#{fileSize},status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE export_log_id=#{exportLogId} AND status='GENERATING'
UPDATE data_export_log SET status='FAILED',failure_reason=#{reason},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE export_log_id=#{id} AND status='GENERATING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_export_log WHERE export_log_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE data_export_log SET download_count=download_count+1,downloaded_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE export_log_id=#{id} AND status='COMPLETED' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE data_export_log SET status='EXPIRED',version=version+1 WHERE export_log_id=#{id} AND status='COMPLETED' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_export_log WHERE status='COMPLETED' AND completed_at<#{before}
SELECT * FROM data_export_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.when: AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_person_id=p.person_id AND a.applicant_user_id=#{scope.userId}) OR (p.initial_scope_user_id=#{scope.userId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence r0 WHERE r0.person_id=p.person_id)))

AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_person_id=p.person_id AND a.applicant_department_id=#{scope.departmentId}) OR (p.initial_scope_department_id=#{scope.departmentId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence r0 WHERE r0.person_id=p.person_id)))

AND (r.region_code IN #{regionCodeItem} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_person_id=p.person_id AND a.applicant_region_code IN #{regionCodeItem}) OR (p.initial_scope_region_code IN #{regionCodeItem} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence r0 WHERE r0.person_id=p.person_id)))

SELECT p.name,p.id_card identityNo,p.phone,p.gender,p.current_status_code status,p.current_address registeredAddress,r.region_code regionCode FROM person p LEFT JOIN residence r ON r.person_id=p.person_id

SELECT ra.person_name_snapshot name,ra.identity_no_snapshot identityNo,ra.registered_address_snapshot registeredAddress,ra.region_code_snapshot regionCode,ra.archive_type archiveType,ra.archived_at archivedAt FROM residence_archive ra WHERE 1=1
AND 1=0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.application_id=ra.application_id AND a.applicant_user_id=#{scope.userId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.application_id=ra.application_id AND a.applicant_department_id=#{scope.departmentId}) AND ra.region_code_snapshot IN #{regionCodeItem} AND 1=0

SELECT c.cancellation_no cancellationNo,c.person_name_snapshot name,c.identity_no_snapshot identityNo,c.address_snapshot registeredAddress,c.region_code_snapshot regionCode,c.business_status status FROM cancellation_record c WHERE 1=1
AND 1=0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.application_id=c.application_id AND a.applicant_user_id=#{scope.userId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.application_id=c.application_id AND a.applicant_department_id=#{scope.departmentId}) AND c.region_code_snapshot IN #{regionCodeItem} AND 1=0

SELECT f.registration_no registrationNo,p.name,p.id_card identityNo,p.phone,f.current_address registeredAddress,f.current_region_code regionCode,f.status FROM floating_population f JOIN person p ON p.person_id=f.person_id WHERE f.current_flag=1
AND 1=0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.application_id=f.source_application_id AND a.applicant_user_id=#{scope.userId}) AND f.department_id=#{scope.departmentId} AND f.current_region_code IN #{regionCodeItem} AND 1=0

SELECT rp.permit_no permitNo,p.name,p.id_card identityNo,p.phone,f.current_address registeredAddress,rp.issue_region_code regionCode,rp.status,rp.valid_until validUntil FROM residence_permit rp JOIN person p ON p.person_id=rp.person_id JOIN floating_population f ON f.floating_id=rp.floating_id WHERE 1=1
AND 1=0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.application_id=rp.source_application_id AND a.applicant_user_id=#{scope.userId}) AND rp.issuing_department_id=#{scope.departmentId} AND rp.issue_region_code IN #{regionCodeItem} AND 1=0

SELECT o.operation_type operationType,o.module_name moduleName,o.operation_time operationTime,o.operation_result operationResult FROM operation_log o WHERE 1=1
AND 1=0
AND o.user_id=#{scope.userId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=o.user_id AND u.department_id=#{scope.departmentId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.department_id=u.department_id WHERE u.user_id=o.user_id AND d.region_code IN #{regionCodeItem}) AND 1=0
choose.otherwise: SELECT operation_type operationType,module_name moduleName,operation_time operationTime,operation_result operationResult FROM operation_log WHERE 1=0
